scheme_name: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Pre-matric Scholarship to Other Backward Classes (OBC) for Studies in India
other_conditions: Scholarship is only for institutions and pre‑matriculation courses recognised by the concerned State Government or Union Territory Administration
Regular attendance of at least 60% in the previous year is required
Beneficiaries cannot avail any other pre‑matric scholarship scheme
30% of the beneficiaries are reserved for girl students
At least 5% of the beneficiaries should be students with disabilities
Day scholars are eligible from class 1st to class 10th, while hostellers are eligible from class 3rd to class 10th
benefits_summary: Hostellers receive ₹500 per month and day scholars ₹100 per month for up to 10 months; an additional ad‑hoc grant of ₹500 per student per year is also provided.
